// Linted as if it lived in packages/sim/src. Nothing here may be reported.
export function dist(dx: number, dz: number): number {
  return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
}
export const mixed = Math.imul(7, 9) ^ (Math.floor(3.5) + Math.round(1.2) + Math.abs(-2));
